_metadata.description: Ground truth dataset for VendorRisk evaluation accuracy testing. Each case represents a vendor evaluation with manually assigned correct recommendation. Used for: (1) accuracy metric computation, (2) RAGAS faithfulness evaluation, (3) CI/CD regression gate.
_metadata.how_to_use: Run tests/eval/run_eval.py to evaluate the live system against these labels. The script queries Supabase for existing evaluation results and computes agreement percentage.

label_criteria.APPROVE: Strong financials, all mandatory certs present with VERIFIED_REGISTRY evidence, no red flags, confidence > 95%
label_criteria.REVIEW: Good fundamentals but certs are CORROBORATED not VERIFIED, or confidence < 95%, or minor concerns requiring sign-off
label_criteria.REJECT: OFAC flag, missing mandatory dealbreaker cert with no evidence, or serious financial/legal red flag

cases.manual_notes: Strong financials (13.9% revenue growth, 18% net margin, D/E 0.10). Certs confirmed via web sources but no EDGAR 10-K available (ADR only). Should be REVIEW because cert evidence is CORROBORATED not VERIFIED_REGISTRY. FedRAMP not applicable (non-US government vendor).
cases.ground_truth_compliance: TCS holds CSA STAR Level 2 (VERIFIED), SOC2 Type II, ISO27001:2013, and ISO9001:2015. OFAC clear. FedRAMP not applicable. All certs corroborated via tatacommunications.com and dqsglobal.com. No EDGAR annual filing available (trades as ADR on NYSE).
cases.ground_truth_financial: Revenue growth 13.9% exceeds 8% benchmark. Net margin 18.05% exceeds 12% benchmark. Debt-to-equity 0.1021 well below 1.5 threshold. Interest coverage 54.37x far exceeds 5x threshold. Credit rating A. Financially strong.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of Tata Consultancy Services for an IT Services procurement in Financial Services industry.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: TCS demonstrates a strong compliance posture. Holds CSA STAR Level 2 (third-party certified), SOC2 Type II, ISO27001:2013, and ISO9001:2015. OFAC clear. Evidence tier is CORROBORATED from web sources. Recommend REVIEW pending verification of SOC2 report documentation.

cases.manual_notes: Infosys 20-F (SEC filing 2026-06-15) explicitly states ISO 27001:2022 certification and SOC 1 and SOC 2 attestation under SSAE 18/ISAE 3402. These are VERIFIED_REGISTRY tier — legally attested. Should score compliance highly. REVIEW because confidence typically below 95% threshold without complete cert set.
cases.ground_truth_compliance: Infosys is certified against ISO 27001:2022 (attested in 20-F SEC filing). SOC 1 and SOC 2 attested under SSAE 18 and ISAE 3402. CSA STAR Level 1 (self-assessment on record). OFAC clear. Evidence tier: ISO27001 and SOC certs are VERIFIED_REGISTRY from SEC filing.
cases.ground_truth_financial: Revenue growth 6.6% below 8% benchmark — minor concern. Net margin 16.4% above 12% benchmark. Interest coverage 96.87x excellent. D/E 0.0983 excellent. Credit rating A. Overall financially healthy despite slightly below-benchmark growth.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of Infosys for a Financial Services procurement with SOC2_Type2 as a dealbreaker requirement.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: Infosys holds ISO27001:2022 certification and SOC1/SOC2 attestation, both confirmed in SEC 20-F filing (VERIFIED_REGISTRY tier). CSA STAR Level 1 on record. OFAC clear. SOC2 dealbreaker requirement is satisfied with VERIFIED_REGISTRY evidence. Recommend REVIEW pending confidence threshold check.

cases.manual_notes: Workday has extensive cert coverage found via web search (compliance.workday.com, trust pages). FedRAMP and CSA_STAR are VERIFIED_REGISTRY. SOC and ISO certs are CORROBORATED from official Workday pages. Excellent cert breadth. REVIEW because web-sourced certs (not EDGAR-verified) keep confidence below 95%.
cases.ground_truth_compliance: Workday holds FedRAMP Moderate authorization (Workday Government Cloud, 2022), CSA STAR Level 2, SOC1 Type II, SOC2 Type II, SOC3, ISO27001, ISO27017, ISO27018, ISO27701, ISO42001. OFAC clear. FedRAMP and CSA STAR are VERIFIED_REGISTRY. All others CORROBORATED from workday.com compliance pages.
cases.ground_truth_financial: Workday is a public company (WDAY). Strong SaaS financial profile with consistent revenue growth. No significant financial concerns.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance certification posture of Workday for a Financial Services procurement.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: Workday demonstrates exceptional compliance breadth with 10 certifications including FedRAMP Moderate (VERIFIED), CSA STAR Level 2 (VERIFIED), and 8 SOC/ISO certifications (CORROBORATED). OFAC clear. Recommend REVIEW for human sign-off given corroborated (not EDGAR-verified) primary certs.

cases.manual_notes: Okta 10-K explicitly mentions SOC2 Type II, CSA STAR, and ISO27001. FedRAMP via marketplace. All 6 certs are VERIFIED_REGISTRY from EDGAR. Strongest evidence tier possible. Should be near APPROVE but confidence check may push to REVIEW. This is the benchmark for VERIFIED_REGISTRY cert quality.
cases.ground_truth_compliance: Okta holds SOC2 Type II, CSA STAR Level 2, ISO27001, ISO27017, ISO27018, and FedRAMP — all confirmed as VERIFIED_REGISTRY (EDGAR 10-K filing + FedRAMP marketplace). OFAC clear. This is the gold standard for compliance evidence quality in this system.
cases.ground_truth_financial: Okta is a public cybersecurity company with strong growth trajectory. Identity management market leader.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of Okta for a high-security Financial Services procurement with SOC2_Type2 as a dealbreaker.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: Okta holds 6 certifications all at VERIFIED_REGISTRY tier (EDGAR 10-K + FedRAMP marketplace). SOC2 Type II dealbreaker satisfied with strongest evidence. OFAC clear. Highest compliance evidence quality possible in this system. Recommend REVIEW at minimum, APPROVE if confidence meets threshold.

cases.manual_notes: Salesforce has extensive compliance coverage but web-sourced. CSA STAR and FedRAMP are VERIFIED_REGISTRY. The remaining 9 certs are CORROBORATED from compliance.salesforce.com. REVIEW because EDGAR extraction did not find cert mentions in their 10-K (not in cert-dense sections).
cases.ground_truth_compliance: Salesforce holds CSA STAR Level 2 (VERIFIED), FedRAMP Moderate (VERIFIED), plus ISO27001, SOC1, SOC2, SOC3, PCI_DSS, ISO27017, ISO27018, ISO27701 (CORROBORATED via compliance.salesforce.com). OFAC clear. Excellent compliance breadth.
cases.ground_truth_financial: Salesforce is a large-cap enterprise SaaS with strong revenue and margin profile. Credit rating A.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of Salesforce as a CRM vendor for Financial Services procurement.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: Salesforce holds 11 certifications including FedRAMP Moderate and CSA STAR Level 2 (both VERIFIED_REGISTRY) plus 9 additional certs at CORROBORATED tier. OFAC clear. Strong compliance breadth suitable for Financial Services procurement. Recommend REVIEW pending human sign-off.

cases.manual_notes: Microsoft is the benchmark for a clean APPROVE. Strong financials, extensive VERIFIED_REGISTRY certs (CSA STAR L2, FedRAMP High), all mandatory IT Services certs present. If the system outputs REVIEW for Microsoft, something is wrong with the confidence calculation or cert extraction.
cases.ground_truth_compliance: Microsoft holds CSA STAR Level 2 (VERIFIED), FedRAMP High (VERIFIED), plus ISO27001, ISO27701, SOC2 Type II, ISO27017, ISO27018, ISO9001, PCI_DSS (CORROBORATED via learn.microsoft.com). OFAC clear. GDPR disclosed as regulatory obligation. Exemplary compliance posture.
cases.ground_truth_financial: Microsoft has exceptional financial profile. Revenue growth, margins, and credit all top-tier. No financial concerns.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of Microsoft Azure for cloud services procurement in Financial Services.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: Microsoft holds 9 certifications with CSA STAR Level 2 and FedRAMP High at VERIFIED_REGISTRY tier. OFAC clear. GDPR compliance disclosed. No compliance concerns. Strong APPROVE recommendation expected for a well-capitalized, extensively certified cloud vendor.

cases.manual_notes: Accenture 10-K mentions ISO27001 and ISO27701 explicitly — VERIFIED_REGISTRY tier from EDGAR. CSA STAR L1 (CORROBORATED) and FedRAMP (VERIFIED). Strong. REVIEW because confidence typically 94% — just below 95% threshold.
cases.ground_truth_compliance: Accenture holds ISO27001 and ISO27701 (VERIFIED_REGISTRY from 10-K SEC filing), FedRAMP (VERIFIED from marketplace), CSA STAR Level 1 (CORROBORATED). OFAC clear. High-quality evidence for core IT Services certs.
cases.ground_truth_financial: Accenture is a large global IT services firm with strong consistent revenue and margins.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of Accenture for IT outsourcing procurement in Financial Services.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: Accenture holds ISO27001 and ISO27701 certified (VERIFIED_REGISTRY from SEC 10-K), FedRAMP authorized (VERIFIED), and CSA STAR Level 1 (CORROBORATED). Strong compliance posture with highest-quality evidence for core IT Services certifications. Recommend REVIEW.

cases.manual_notes: IBM has EDGAR resolution issues (IBM Credit Corp vs IBM Corp CIK collision). CSA STAR Level 2 VERIFIED and FedRAMP VERIFIED from marketplace. ISO27001 CORROBORATED from IBM support pages. REVIEW because EDGAR resolution fails for short name and cert coverage is narrower than expected for IBM.
cases.ground_truth_compliance: IBM holds CSA STAR Level 2 (IBM Cloud) VERIFIED and FedRAMP High (IBM Cloud for Government) VERIFIED. ISO27001 CORROBORATED. OFAC clear. Note: EDGAR extraction fails due to CIK collision (IBM Credit Corp vs IBM Corp) — this is a known architectural limitation for short-name disambiguation.
cases.ground_truth_financial: IBM is a large public company with stable financials. Long operational history.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of IBM for cloud services procurement.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: IBM holds CSA STAR Level 2 and FedRAMP High (both VERIFIED_REGISTRY from registries) plus ISO27001 (CORROBORATED). OFAC clear. EDGAR extraction limited due to short-name collision. Core government-grade certifications present. Recommend REVIEW.

cases.manual_notes: CrowdStrike 10-K mentions FedRAMP explicitly (risk disclosure of losing authorization). CSA STAR Level 2 VERIFIED. FedRAMP from marketplace. Should have more certs (ISO27001, SOC2) but EDGAR extraction may not capture them if rate limited. REVIEW is correct.
cases.ground_truth_compliance: CrowdStrike holds FedRAMP (Falcon Platform, Moderate, VERIFIED from marketplace) and CSA STAR Level 2 (VERIFIED). ISO27001 and SOC2 likely held but not captured due to EDGAR extraction rate limits in testing. OFAC clear. Core cybersecurity certs present.
cases.ground_truth_financial: CrowdStrike is a high-growth cybersecurity company with strong ARR growth. Public company on NASDAQ.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of CrowdStrike for cybersecurity vendor procurement.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: CrowdStrike holds FedRAMP Moderate (VERIFIED) and CSA STAR Level 2 (VERIFIED). Additional certs likely but not captured. OFAC clear. Strong government-grade cybersecurity certifications present. Recommend REVIEW.

cases.manual_notes: Wipro 20-F found via EDGAR. Cert mentions in filing but EDGAR extraction limited. Web fallback finds ISO27001, ISO27701, ISO9001, ISO27018 via wipro.com PDFs. CSA STAR Level 1 CORROBORATED. No FedRAMP. REVIEW appropriate.
cases.ground_truth_compliance: Wipro holds CSA STAR Level 1 (CORROBORATED), ISO27001, ISO27701, ISO9001 (CORROBORATED via wipro.com PDF documentation). No FedRAMP. OFAC clear. Solid but non-government-grade compliance profile for an Indian IT services firm.
cases.ground_truth_financial: Wipro is a large Indian IT services company listed on NYSE as ADR. Stable financial profile with international operations.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of Wipro for IT outsourcing procurement.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: Wipro holds CSA STAR Level 1, ISO27001, ISO27701, ISO9001 all at CORROBORATED tier from official Wipro documentation. No FedRAMP. OFAC clear. Adequate IT Services compliance posture. Recommend REVIEW with documentation request.

cases.manual_notes: Vanta is a private GRC SaaS company. No EDGAR listing. No FedRAMP. No CSA STAR in seed. Web fallback gets to vanta.com but rate limits typically prevent extraction. Known that Vanta holds SOC2 (they literally certify others for SOC2) but no registry evidence. Low composite expected due to thin cert evidence. REVIEW correct.
cases.ground_truth_compliance: Vanta is a private compliance automation company. Holds SOC2 (confirmed by public knowledge — they are a SOC2 certification platform) but no VERIFIED_REGISTRY evidence available. OFAC clear. Classic case where self-report is the only available evidence tier.
cases.ground_truth_financial: Vanta is a private company. No financial data available via yfinance. Revenue and growth unknown to the system.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of Vanta as a GRC SaaS vendor for compliance automation procurement.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: Vanta is a private company with no EDGAR listing, FedRAMP, or CSA STAR registry entries. Holds SOC2 by reputation (public knowledge as compliance automation platform) but no VERIFIED_REGISTRY evidence available. OFAC clear. Recommend REVIEW with direct request for SOC2 report documentation.

cases.manual_notes: SAP SE is a German company filing 20-F with the SEC. CIK resolves correctly. EDGAR extraction sometimes rate-limited. CSA STAR Level 2 VERIFIED (SAP Cloud Platform). FedRAMP VERIFIED (SAP NS2). REVIEW appropriate given cert evidence comes from registries not EDGAR.
cases.ground_truth_compliance: SAP SE holds CSA STAR Level 2 (SAP Cloud Platform, VERIFIED) and FedRAMP Moderate (SAP NS2 Cloud, VERIFIED). OFAC clear. European company with strong data protection posture. ISO27001 likely held but not captured in standard extraction.
cases.ground_truth_financial: SAP SE is a large-cap German enterprise software company listed on NYSE. Strong stable financials.
cases.ragas_question: Evaluate the compliance posture of SAP SE for enterprise software procurement.
cases.ragas_ground_truth: SAP SE holds CSA STAR Level 2 and FedRAMP Moderate (both VERIFIED_REGISTRY). OFAC clear. European data protection compliance expected. Good compliance posture for enterprise software. Recommend REVIEW.
